This role focuses on building enterprise-grade backend solutions using Java Spring technologies while leveraging modern architectural practices, including AI integration, microservices, intelligent search, and cloud-native development. Build and maintain RESTful APIs for internal and external integrations. Develop high-performance backend solutions using Oracle and/or MySQL databases. Work within Docker and Kubernetes-based environments. Develop automated unit and integration tests. Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards. Apply secure coding practices and OWASP security recommendations. Collaboration Work closely with Product Management, UX, QA, DevOps, and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions. Participate in technical discussions, design reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities. Support and mentor junior developers when needed. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development lifecycle. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Experience with prompt engineering and effective utilization of LLM-based solutions. Understanding application architectures leveraging LLM APIs. Familiarity with Python development. Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in enterprise environments. Understanding AI-aware software architecture and development principles. Awareness of AI security, governance, and compliance considerations. Soft Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills. Effective communication and collaboration abilities. Ability to work closely with both technical and business stakeholders. Proactive mindset with a passion for continuous learning and improvement. Strong sense of ownership and accountability for deliverables. Adaptability to evolving technologies, especially AI-driven solutions and modern software architectures.
